<script>
// --- Cancel native hash auto-scroll when the user opens the menu before load ---
// If the page is opened with a fragment (e.g. /products/gpu#pricing) the browser
// auto-scrolls to that element after load. If the user opens the top menu
// (desktop mega-menu or mobile hamburger) before load completes, strip the hash
// so that auto-scroll is disabled and the URL no longer points at the section.
(function () {
  // Nothing to guard if we did not land on a fragment
  if (!window.location.hash) return;

  // Covers desktop mega-menu triggers and the mobile menu toggle (hamburger)
  var MENU_TRIGGER_SELECTOR = '.bcl-nav-list__item-link, [data-cmp-hook-header="menu-toggle"]';

  function onEarlyMenuOpen(e) {
    // Skip once the initial hash scroll is resolved (already ran or interrupted).
    // Gating on this shared flag (not on page-load state) avoids the race where
    // the click and the load event fire at nearly the same time.
    if (window.initialHashHandled) return;
    if (!e.target.closest(MENU_TRIGGER_SELECTOR)) return;

    // Shared flag: tells the JS smooth-scroll (z-z-pageScroll.js) to skip the
    // initial hash auto-scroll because the user interrupted it.
    window.initialHashHandled = true;

    // 1) Remove the fragment BEFORE the post-load scroll runs, so there is no
    //    target left for the browser to scroll to.
    if (window.location.hash) {
      history.replaceState(null, document.title, location.pathname + location.search);
    }

    // 2) Insurance for browsers that already queued the jump: hold position.
    var y = window.scrollY;
    var hold = function () { window.scrollTo(0, y); };
    hold();
    requestAnimationFrame(hold);
    window.addEventListener('load', hold, { once: true });

    // One-shot: nothing left to strip after the first menu interaction
    document.removeEventListener('click', onEarlyMenuOpen, true);
  }

  // Capture phase so this runs independently of (and before) the menu handlers
  document.addEventListener('click', onEarlyMenuOpen, true);
})();

(function () {
  const MOBILE_BREAK = 860;
  const header = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2');
  const desktopItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-nav-list__item'));
  if (!header || desktopItems.length === 0) {
    console.warn('Desktop nav: header or dropdown items not found.');
    return;
  }

  let docListenerAttached = false;

  function isMobile() {
    return window.innerWidth <= MOBILE_BREAK;
  }

  function getScrollbarWidth() {
    return window.innerWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  }

  function lockScrollStable() {
    const scrollbarWidth = getScrollbarWidth();
    document.documentElement.classList.add('no-scroll');
  }

  function unlockScrollStable() {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  }

  function closeItemsOnly() {
    desktopItems.forEach(item => {
      item.classList.remove('is-open');
      const l = item.querySelector('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
      const d = item.querySelector('.main-nav__dropdown');
      if (l) l.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      if (d) d.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    });
  }

  // Centralized close logic
  function closeAll() {
    closeItemsOnly();
    document.querySelectorAll('header.experiencefragment')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('fixed--header'));

    const overlay = document.querySelector('.nav-overlay');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');

    if (!isMobile()) {
      unlockScrollStable();
    }
    //added as part of bcl header v2
    document.querySelectorAll('.header-container.create-account__container')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

      document.querySelectorAll('.create-account__container_mobile')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

  }

  function closeCreateAccount() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.header-container.create-account__container')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.create-account__container_mobile')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeLoginDropdown() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-dropdown__text.active')
      .forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeLanguageDropdown() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-languagenavigation__current-code.active')
      .forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeSearch() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-search-content-wrapper.active').forEach(function(panel) {
      const toggle = panel.parentElement && panel.parentElement.querySelector("[data-cmp-hook-search='search-toggle']");
      if (toggle) toggle.click();
    });
  }

  // Document click handler
  function onDocumentClickClose(e) {
    if (e && e.target) {
      const allDropdowns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav__dropdown'));
      if (allDropdowns.some(dd => dd && dd.contains(e.target))) {
        return; // ignore clicks inside dropdown
      }
    }

    if (docListenerAttached) {
      document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
      docListenerAttached = false;
    }

    closeAll();
  }

  function attachDocListenerOnce() {
    if (docListenerAttached) return;
    document.addEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
    docListenerAttached = true;
  }

  function setDropdownHeight(){
      let header = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2');
      let headerHeight = header ? header.offsetHeight : 0;

      // dropdown height
      let dropdownHeight = headerHeight;

      // eyebrow height (if exists)
      let eyebrow = document.querySelector('.bcl-eyebrow');
      if (eyebrow) {
          dropdownHeight += eyebrow.offsetHeight;
      }
      if(isMobile()){
          dropdownHeight = -dropdownHeight+5;
      }else{
          dropdownHeight = dropdownHeight;
      }

        document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav__dropdown').forEach(dropdown => {
          if(isMobile()){
              dropdown.style.top =0;
              dropdown.style.height = '100vh';
              dropdown.style.overflowY = 'auto';
          }else{
              dropdown.style.top = dropdownHeight + 'px';
              dropdown.style.height = 'auto';
          }
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-overlay').forEach(dropdown => {
          dropdown.style.top = dropdownHeight + 'px';
      });
  }

  desktopItems.forEach(item => {
    const link = item.querySelector('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
    const dropdown = item.querySelector('.main-nav__dropdown');
    if (!link || !dropdown) return;

    link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (isMobile()) return;
      e.preventDefault();

      const wasOpen = item.classList.contains('is-open');

      if (wasOpen) {
        closeAll();
        if (docListenerAttached) {
          document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
          docListenerAttached = false;
        }
        return;
      }

      closeItemsOnly();

      // If it was closed, open it now
      item.classList.add('is-open');

      document.querySelectorAll('header.experiencefragment')
        .forEach(h => h.classList.add('fixed--header'));

      document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-dropdown__text')
        .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

      link.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      dropdown.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

      const overlay = document.querySelector('.nav-overlay');
      if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('active');

      lockScrollStable();
      requestAnimationFrame(setDropdownHeight);

      setTimeout(attachDocListenerOnce, 0);
    });

    // Keyboard accessibility
    link.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (isMobile()) return;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        link.click();
      }
    });
  });


  function handleTabs() {
      const tabLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tab'))
          .filter(tab => !tab.classList.contains('link-tab')); // ignore link-tabs

      const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tabpanel');

      // bind click only to real tabs
      tabLinks.forEach(tab => {
          tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const panelId = tab.getAttribute('aria-controls').replace(/-tabpanel$/, '');

              // deactivate all
              tabLinks.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('cmp-tabs__tab--active'));
              tabPanels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active'));

              // activate selected
              tab.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tab--active');
              const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
              if (panel) panel.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active');
          });
      });

      if (tabLinks.length > 0) {
          tabLinks[0].click();
      }
  }

  function createAccountHandler() {

    const buttonWrapper = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2__main__secondary');
    if(buttonWrapper){
      const button = buttonWrapper.querySelector('.bcl-button');
      if(button){
        button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const container = document.querySelector('.header-container.create-account__container');
            const containerMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
            if (container && container.classList.contains('active')) {
                container.classList.remove('active');
                containerMobile.classList.remove('active');
            }else{
              closeAll();
              closeLoginDropdown();
              closeLanguageDropdown();
              closeSearch();
              container.classList.add('active');
              containerMobile.classList.add('active');
              if (isMobile()) {
                lockScrollStable();
              }
            }
          });

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const container = document.querySelector('.header-container.create-account__container');
            const containerMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
            if (container && container.classList.contains('active')) {
                if (!container.contains(e.target) && !button.contains(e.target)) {
                    container.classList.remove('active');
                    containerMobile.classList.remove('active');
                }
            }
          });

        const createAccountMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
        if (createAccountMobile) {
          const closeBtn = createAccountMobile.querySelector('.close-button');
          if (closeBtn) {
            closeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              closeAll();
              const menuToggle = document.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-header="menu-toggle"]');
              const menu = document.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-header="menu"]');
              if (menuToggle) menuToggle.classList.remove('active');
              if (menu) menu.classList.remove('active');
              unlockScrollStable();
            });
          }
        }
    }
  }
}

  if (!isMobile()) {
    handleTabs();
  }
  createAccountHandler();

  // Close create account when login dropdown, language nav, or search opens
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const loginTrigger = e.target.closest('.bcl-dropdown__text');
    const langTrigger = e.target.closest('.bcl-languagenavigation__current-code');
    const searchTrigger = e.target.closest("[data-cmp-hook-search='search-toggle']");
    if (loginTrigger || langTrigger) {
      closeCreateAccount();
    }
    if (searchTrigger) {
      // Close create account only when search is being opened (panel not yet active)
      const searchPanel = searchTrigger.parentElement &&
        searchTrigger.parentElement.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-search="search"]');
      if (!searchPanel || !searchPanel.classList.contains('active')) {
        closeCreateAccount();
      }
    }
  });

  // ESC closes all
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (docListenerAttached) {
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
        docListenerAttached = false;
      }
      closeAll();
    }
  });


    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        const navLink = e.target.closest('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
        if (!navLink) return;

        const width = window.innerWidth;

        // Only override between 861 and 1140
        if (width < 861 || width > 1140) return;

        const tablist = document.querySelectorAll(
            '.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tablist .cmp-tabs__tab'
        );
        if (!tablist.length) return;

        // Check if any tab already has active class
        const hasActiveTab = [...tablist].some(tab =>
            tab.classList.contains('cmp-tabs__tab--active')
        );

        // If any tab is already active, do not override
        if (hasActiveTab) return;


        const firstTab = document.querySelector(
            '.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tablist .cmp-tabs__tab'
        );
        if (!firstTab) return;

        // Activate first tab
        firstTab.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tab--active');

        // Activate its corresponding panel
        const panelId = firstTab.getAttribute('aria-controls');
        if (!panelId) return;

        const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active');
        }
    });

  var lastWidth = window.innerWidth;
  // Cleanup on resize to mobile
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (isMobile()) {
      const currentWidth = window.innerWidth;
      // Ignore mobile browser UI resize during scroll
      if (currentWidth === lastWidth) return;

      lastWidth = currentWidth;

      closeAll();

      if (docListenerAttached) {
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
        docListenerAttached = false;
      }
    }
  });
  window.closeMegaMenu = closeAll;

})();
</script>

<script>
// --- Cancel native hash auto-scroll when the user opens the menu before load ---
// If the page is opened with a fragment (e.g. /products/gpu#pricing) the browser
// auto-scrolls to that element after load. If the user opens the top menu
// (desktop mega-menu or mobile hamburger) before load completes, strip the hash
// so that auto-scroll is disabled and the URL no longer points at the section.
(function () {
  // Nothing to guard if we did not land on a fragment
  if (!window.location.hash) return;

  // Covers desktop mega-menu triggers and the mobile menu toggle (hamburger)
  var MENU_TRIGGER_SELECTOR = '.bcl-nav-list__item-link, [data-cmp-hook-header="menu-toggle"]';

  function onEarlyMenuOpen(e) {
    // Skip once the initial hash scroll is resolved (already ran or interrupted).
    // Gating on this shared flag (not on page-load state) avoids the race where
    // the click and the load event fire at nearly the same time.
    if (window.initialHashHandled) return;
    if (!e.target.closest(MENU_TRIGGER_SELECTOR)) return;

    // Shared flag: tells the JS smooth-scroll (z-z-pageScroll.js) to skip the
    // initial hash auto-scroll because the user interrupted it.
    window.initialHashHandled = true;

    // 1) Remove the fragment BEFORE the post-load scroll runs, so there is no
    //    target left for the browser to scroll to.
    if (window.location.hash) {
      history.replaceState(null, document.title, location.pathname + location.search);
    }

    // 2) Insurance for browsers that already queued the jump: hold position.
    var y = window.scrollY;
    var hold = function () { window.scrollTo(0, y); };
    hold();
    requestAnimationFrame(hold);
    window.addEventListener('load', hold, { once: true });

    // One-shot: nothing left to strip after the first menu interaction
    document.removeEventListener('click', onEarlyMenuOpen, true);
  }

  // Capture phase so this runs independently of (and before) the menu handlers
  document.addEventListener('click', onEarlyMenuOpen, true);
})();

(function () {
  const MOBILE_BREAK = 860;
  const header = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2');
  const desktopItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-nav-list__item'));
  if (!header || desktopItems.length === 0) {
    console.warn('Desktop nav: header or dropdown items not found.');
    return;
  }

  let docListenerAttached = false;

  function isMobile() {
    return window.innerWidth <= MOBILE_BREAK;
  }

  function getScrollbarWidth() {
    return window.innerWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  }

  function lockScrollStable() {
    const scrollbarWidth = getScrollbarWidth();
    document.documentElement.classList.add('no-scroll');
  }

  function unlockScrollStable() {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  }

  function closeItemsOnly() {
    desktopItems.forEach(item => {
      item.classList.remove('is-open');
      const l = item.querySelector('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
      const d = item.querySelector('.main-nav__dropdown');
      if (l) l.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      if (d) d.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    });
  }

  // Centralized close logic
  function closeAll() {
    closeItemsOnly();
    document.querySelectorAll('header.experiencefragment')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('fixed--header'));

    const overlay = document.querySelector('.nav-overlay');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');

    if (!isMobile()) {
      unlockScrollStable();
    }
    //added as part of bcl header v2
    document.querySelectorAll('.header-container.create-account__container')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

      document.querySelectorAll('.create-account__container_mobile')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

  }

  function closeCreateAccount() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.header-container.create-account__container')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.create-account__container_mobile')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeLoginDropdown() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-dropdown__text.active')
      .forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeLanguageDropdown() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-languagenavigation__current-code.active')
      .forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeSearch() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-search-content-wrapper.active').forEach(function(panel) {
      const toggle = panel.parentElement && panel.parentElement.querySelector("[data-cmp-hook-search='search-toggle']");
      if (toggle) toggle.click();
    });
  }

  // Document click handler
  function onDocumentClickClose(e) {
    if (e && e.target) {
      const allDropdowns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav__dropdown'));
      if (allDropdowns.some(dd => dd && dd.contains(e.target))) {
        return; // ignore clicks inside dropdown
      }
    }

    if (docListenerAttached) {
      document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
      docListenerAttached = false;
    }

    closeAll();
  }

  function attachDocListenerOnce() {
    if (docListenerAttached) return;
    document.addEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
    docListenerAttached = true;
  }

  function setDropdownHeight(){
      let header = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2');
      let headerHeight = header ? header.offsetHeight : 0;

      // dropdown height
      let dropdownHeight = headerHeight;

      // eyebrow height (if exists)
      let eyebrow = document.querySelector('.bcl-eyebrow');
      if (eyebrow) {
          dropdownHeight += eyebrow.offsetHeight;
      }
      if(isMobile()){
          dropdownHeight = -dropdownHeight+5;
      }else{
          dropdownHeight = dropdownHeight;
      }

        document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav__dropdown').forEach(dropdown => {
          if(isMobile()){
              dropdown.style.top =0;
              dropdown.style.height = '100vh';
              dropdown.style.overflowY = 'auto';
          }else{
              dropdown.style.top = dropdownHeight + 'px';
              dropdown.style.height = 'auto';
          }
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-overlay').forEach(dropdown => {
          dropdown.style.top = dropdownHeight + 'px';
      });
  }

  desktopItems.forEach(item => {
    const link = item.querySelector('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
    const dropdown = item.querySelector('.main-nav__dropdown');
    if (!link || !dropdown) return;

    link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (isMobile()) return;
      e.preventDefault();

      const wasOpen = item.classList.contains('is-open');

      if (wasOpen) {
        closeAll();
        if (docListenerAttached) {
          document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
          docListenerAttached = false;
        }
        return;
      }

      closeItemsOnly();

      // If it was closed, open it now
      item.classList.add('is-open');

      document.querySelectorAll('header.experiencefragment')
        .forEach(h => h.classList.add('fixed--header'));

      document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-dropdown__text')
        .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

      link.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      dropdown.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

      const overlay = document.querySelector('.nav-overlay');
      if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('active');

      lockScrollStable();
      requestAnimationFrame(setDropdownHeight);

      setTimeout(attachDocListenerOnce, 0);
    });

    // Keyboard accessibility
    link.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (isMobile()) return;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        link.click();
      }
    });
  });


  function handleTabs() {
      const tabLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tab'))
          .filter(tab => !tab.classList.contains('link-tab')); // ignore link-tabs

      const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tabpanel');

      // bind click only to real tabs
      tabLinks.forEach(tab => {
          tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const panelId = tab.getAttribute('aria-controls').replace(/-tabpanel$/, '');

              // deactivate all
              tabLinks.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('cmp-tabs__tab--active'));
              tabPanels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active'));

              // activate selected
              tab.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tab--active');
              const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
              if (panel) panel.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active');
          });
      });

      if (tabLinks.length > 0) {
          tabLinks[0].click();
      }
  }

  function createAccountHandler() {

    const buttonWrapper = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2__main__secondary');
    if(buttonWrapper){
      const button = buttonWrapper.querySelector('.bcl-button');
      if(button){
        button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const container = document.querySelector('.header-container.create-account__container');

            if (container && container.classList.contains('active')) {

                containerMobile.classList.remove('active');
            }else{
              closeAll();
              closeLoginDropdown();
              closeLanguageDropdown();
              closeSearch();
              container.classList.add('active');
              containerMobile.classList.add('active');
              if (isMobile()) {
                lockScrollStable();
              }
            }
          });

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const container = document.querySelector('.header-container.create-account__container');
            const containerMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
            if (container && container.classList.contains('active')) {
                if (!container.contains(e.target) && !button.contains(e.target)) {
                    container.classList.remove('active');
                    containerMobile.classList.remove('active');
                }
            }
          });

        const createAccountMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
        if (createAccountMobile) {
          const closeBtn = createAccountMobile.querySelector('.close-button');
          if (closeBtn) {
            closeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              closeAll();
              const menuToggle = document.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-header="menu-toggle"]');
              const menu = document.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-header="menu"]');

              unlockScrollStable();
            });
          }
        }
    }
  }

  if (!isMobile()) {
    handleTabs();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const loginTrigger = e.target.closest('.bcl-dropdown__text');
    const langTrigger = e.target.closest('.bcl-languagenavigation__current-code');
    const searchTrigger = e.target.closest("[data-cmp-hook-search='search-toggle']");
    if (loginTrigger || langTrigger) {
      closeCreateAccount();
    }
    if (searchTrigger) {
      // Close create account only when search is being opened (panel not yet active)
      const searchPanel = searchTrigger.parentElement &&
        searchTrigger.parentElement.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-search="search"]');
      if (!searchPanel || !searchPanel.classList.contains('active')) {
        closeCreateAccount();
      }
    }
  });

  // ESC closes all
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (docListenerAttached) {
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
        docListenerAttached = false;
      }
      closeAll();
    }
  });


    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        const navLink = e.target.closest('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
        if (!navLink) return;

        const width = window.innerWidth;

        // Only override between 861 and 1140
        if (width < 861 || width > 1140) return;

        const tablist = document.querySelectorAll(
            '.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tablist .cmp-tabs__tab'
        );
        if (!tablist.length) return;

        // Check if any tab already has active class
        const hasActiveTab = [...tablist].some(tab =>
            tab.classList.contains('cmp-tabs__tab--active')
        );

        // If any tab is already active, do not override
        if (hasActiveTab) return;


        const firstTab = document.querySelector(
            '.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tablist .cmp-tabs__tab'
        );
        if (!firstTab) return;

        // Activate first tab
        firstTab.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tab--active');

        // Activate its corresponding panel
        const panelId = firstTab.getAttribute('aria-controls');
        if (!panelId) return;

        const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active');
        }
    });

  var lastWidth = window.innerWidth;
  // Cleanup on resize to mobile
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (isMobile()) {
      const currentWidth = window.innerWidth;
      // Ignore mobile browser UI resize during scroll
      if (currentWidth === lastWidth) return;

      lastWidth = currentWidth;

      closeAll();

      if (docListenerAttached) {
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
        docListenerAttached = false;
      }
    }
  });
  window.closeMegaMenu = closeAll;

<script>
// --- Cancel native hash auto-scroll when the user opens the menu before load ---
// If the page is opened with a fragment (e.g. /products/gpu#pricing) the browser
// auto-scrolls to that element after load. If the user opens the top menu
// (desktop mega-menu or mobile hamburger) before load completes, strip the hash
// so that auto-scroll is disabled and the URL no longer points at the section.
(function () {
  // Nothing to guard if we did not land on a fragment
  if (!window.location.hash) return;

  // Covers desktop mega-menu triggers and the mobile menu toggle (hamburger)
  var MENU_TRIGGER_SELECTOR = '.bcl-nav-list__item-link, [data-cmp-hook-header="menu-toggle"]';

  function onEarlyMenuOpen(e) {
    // Skip once the initial hash scroll is resolved (already ran or interrupted).
    // Gating on this shared flag (not on page-load state) avoids the race where
    // the click and the load event fire at nearly the same time.
    if (window.initialHashHandled) return;
    if (!e.target.closest(MENU_TRIGGER_SELECTOR)) return;

    // Shared flag: tells the JS smooth-scroll (z-z-pageScroll.js) to skip the
    // initial hash auto-scroll because the user interrupted it.
    window.initialHashHandled = true;

    // 1) Remove the fragment BEFORE the post-load scroll runs, so there is no
    //    target left for the browser to scroll to.
    if (window.location.hash) {
      history.replaceState(null, document.title, location.pathname + location.search);
    }

    // 2) Insurance for browsers that already queued the jump: hold position.
    var y = window.scrollY;
    var hold = function () { window.scrollTo(0, y); };
    hold();
    requestAnimationFrame(hold);
    window.addEventListener('load', hold, { once: true });

    // One-shot: nothing left to strip after the first menu interaction
    document.removeEventListener('click', onEarlyMenuOpen, true);
  }

  // Capture phase so this runs independently of (and before) the menu handlers
  document.addEventListener('click', onEarlyMenuOpen, true);
})();

(function () {
  const MOBILE_BREAK = 860;
  const header = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2');
  const desktopItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-nav-list__item'));
  if (!header || desktopItems.length === 0) {
    console.warn('Desktop nav: header or dropdown items not found.');
    return;
  }

  let docListenerAttached = false;

  function isMobile() {
    return window.innerWidth <= MOBILE_BREAK;
  }

  function getScrollbarWidth() {
    return window.innerWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  }

  function lockScrollStable() {
    const scrollbarWidth = getScrollbarWidth();
    document.documentElement.classList.add('no-scroll');
  }

  function unlockScrollStable() {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  }

  function closeItemsOnly() {
    desktopItems.forEach(item => {
      item.classList.remove('is-open');
      const l = item.querySelector('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
      const d = item.querySelector('.main-nav__dropdown');
      if (l) l.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      if (d) d.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    });
  }

  // Centralized close logic
  function closeAll() {
    closeItemsOnly();
    document.querySelectorAll('header.experiencefragment')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('fixed--header'));

    const overlay = document.querySelector('.nav-overlay');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');

    if (!isMobile()) {
      unlockScrollStable();
    }
    //added as part of bcl header v2
    document.querySelectorAll('.header-container.create-account__container')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

      document.querySelectorAll('.create-account__container_mobile')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

  }

  function closeCreateAccount() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.header-container.create-account__container')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.create-account__container_mobile')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeLoginDropdown() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-dropdown__text.active')
      .forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeLanguageDropdown() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-languagenavigation__current-code.active')
      .forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeSearch() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-search-content-wrapper.active').forEach(function(panel) {
      const toggle = panel.parentElement && panel.parentElement.querySelector("[data-cmp-hook-search='search-toggle']");
      if (toggle) toggle.click();
    });
  }

  // Document click handler
  function onDocumentClickClose(e) {
    if (e && e.target) {
      const allDropdowns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav__dropdown'));
      if (allDropdowns.some(dd => dd && dd.contains(e.target))) {
        return; // ignore clicks inside dropdown
      }
    }

    if (docListenerAttached) {
      document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
      docListenerAttached = false;
    }

    closeAll();
  }

  function attachDocListenerOnce() {
    if (docListenerAttached) return;
    document.addEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
    docListenerAttached = true;
  }

  function setDropdownHeight(){
      let header = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2');
      let headerHeight = header ? header.offsetHeight : 0;

      // dropdown height
      let dropdownHeight = headerHeight;

      // eyebrow height (if exists)
      let eyebrow = document.querySelector('.bcl-eyebrow');
      if (eyebrow) {
          dropdownHeight += eyebrow.offsetHeight;
      }
      if(isMobile()){
          dropdownHeight = -dropdownHeight+5;
      }else{
          dropdownHeight = dropdownHeight;
      }

        document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav__dropdown').forEach(dropdown => {
          if(isMobile()){
              dropdown.style.top =0;
              dropdown.style.height = '100vh';
              dropdown.style.overflowY = 'auto';
          }else{
              dropdown.style.top = dropdownHeight + 'px';
              dropdown.style.height = 'auto';
          }
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-overlay').forEach(dropdown => {
          dropdown.style.top = dropdownHeight + 'px';
      });
  }

  desktopItems.forEach(item => {
    const link = item.querySelector('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
    const dropdown = item.querySelector('.main-nav__dropdown');
    if (!link || !dropdown) return;

    link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (isMobile()) return;
      e.preventDefault();

      const wasOpen = item.classList.contains('is-open');

      if (wasOpen) {
        closeAll();
        if (docListenerAttached) {
          document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
          docListenerAttached = false;
        }
        return;
      }

      closeItemsOnly();

      // If it was closed, open it now
      item.classList.add('is-open');

      document.querySelectorAll('header.experiencefragment')
        .forEach(h => h.classList.add('fixed--header'));

      document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-dropdown__text')
        .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

      link.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      dropdown.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

      const overlay = document.querySelector('.nav-overlay');
      if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('active');

      lockScrollStable();
      requestAnimationFrame(setDropdownHeight);

      setTimeout(attachDocListenerOnce, 0);
    });

    // Keyboard accessibility
    link.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (isMobile()) return;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        link.click();
      }
    });
  });


  function handleTabs() {
      const tabLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tab'))
          .filter(tab => !tab.classList.contains('link-tab')); // ignore link-tabs

      const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tabpanel');

      // bind click only to real tabs
      tabLinks.forEach(tab => {
          tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const panelId = tab.getAttribute('aria-controls').replace(/-tabpanel$/, '');

              // deactivate all
              tabLinks.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('cmp-tabs__tab--active'));
              tabPanels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active'));

              // activate selected
              tab.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tab--active');
              const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
              if (panel) panel.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active');
          });
      });

      if (tabLinks.length > 0) {
          tabLinks[0].click();
      }
  }

  function createAccountHandler() {

    const buttonWrapper = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2__main__secondary');
    if(buttonWrapper){
      const button = buttonWrapper.querySelector('.bcl-button');
      if(button){
        button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const container = document.querySelector('.header-container.create-account__container');
            const containerMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
            if (container && container.classList.contains('active')) {
                container.classList.remove('active');
                containerMobile.classList.remove('active');
            }else{
              closeAll();
              closeLoginDropdown();
              closeLanguageDropdown();
              closeSearch();
              container.classList.add('active');
              containerMobile.classList.add('active');
              if (isMobile()) {
                lockScrollStable();
              }
            }
          });

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const container = document.querySelector('.header-container.create-account__container');
            const containerMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
            if (container && container.classList.contains('active')) {
                if (!container.contains(e.target) && !button.contains(e.target)) {
                    container.classList.remove('active');
                    containerMobile.classList.remove('active');
                }
            }
          });

        const createAccountMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
        if (createAccountMobile) {
          const closeBtn = createAccountMobile.querySelector('.close-button');
          if (closeBtn) {
            closeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              closeAll();
              const menuToggle = document.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-header="menu-toggle"]');
              const menu = document.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-header="menu"]');
              if (menuToggle) menuToggle.classList.remove('active');
              if (menu) menu.classList.remove('active');
              unlockScrollStable();
            });
          }
        }
    }
  }
}

  if (!isMobile()) {
    handleTabs();
  }
  createAccountHandler();

  // Close create account when login dropdown, language nav, or search opens
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const loginTrigger = e.target.closest('.bcl-dropdown__text');
    const langTrigger = e.target.closest('.bcl-languagenavigation__current-code');
    const searchTrigger = e.target.closest("[data-cmp-hook-search='search-toggle']");
    if (loginTrigger || langTrigger) {
      closeCreateAccount();
    }
    if (searchTrigger) {
      // Close create account only when search is being opened (panel not yet active)
      const searchPanel = searchTrigger.parentElement &&
        searchTrigger.parentElement.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-search="search"]');
      if (!searchPanel || !searchPanel.classList.contains('active')) {
        closeCreateAccount();
      }
    }
  });

  // ESC closes all
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (docListenerAttached) {
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
        docListenerAttached = false;
      }
      closeAll();
    }
  });


    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        const navLink = e.target.closest('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
        if (!navLink) return;

        const width = window.innerWidth;

        // Only override between 861 and 1140
        if (width < 861 || width > 1140) return;

        const tablist = document.querySelectorAll(
            '.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tablist .cmp-tabs__tab'
        );
        if (!tablist.length) return;

        // Check if any tab already has active class
        const hasActiveTab = [...tablist].some(tab =>
            tab.classList.contains('cmp-tabs__tab--active')
        );

        // If any tab is already active, do not override
        if (hasActiveTab) return;


        const firstTab = document.querySelector(
            '.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tablist .cmp-tabs__tab'
        );
        if (!firstTab) return;

        // Activate first tab
        firstTab.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tab--active');

        // Activate its corresponding panel
        const panelId = firstTab.getAttribute('aria-controls');
        if (!panelId) return;

        const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active');
        }
    });

  var lastWidth = window.innerWidth;
  // Cleanup on resize to mobile
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (isMobile()) {
      const currentWidth = window.innerWidth;
      // Ignore mobile browser UI resize during scroll
      if (currentWidth === lastWidth) return;

      lastWidth = currentWidth;

      closeAll();

      if (docListenerAttached) {
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
        docListenerAttached = false;
      }
    }
  });
  window.closeMegaMenu = closeAll;

})();
</script>

    if (!e.target.closest(MENU_TRIGGER_SELECTOR)) return;

    // Shared flag: tells the JS smooth-scroll (z-z-pageScroll.js) to skip the
    // initial hash auto-scroll because the user interrupted it.
    window.initialHashHandled = true;

    // 1) Remove the fragment BEFORE the post-load scroll runs, so there is no
    //    target left for the browser to scroll to.
    if (window.location.hash) {
      history.replaceState(null, document.title, location.pathname + location.search);
    }

    // 2) Insurance for browsers that already queued the jump: hold position.
    var y = window.scrollY;
    var hold = function () { window.scrollTo(0, y); };
    hold();
    requestAnimationFrame(hold);
    window.addEventListener('load', hold, { once: true });

    // One-shot: nothing left to strip after the first menu interaction
    document.removeEventListener('click', onEarlyMenuOpen, true);
  }

  // Capture phase so this runs independently of (and before) the menu handlers
  document.addEventListener('click', onEarlyMenuOpen, true);
})();

(function () {
  const MOBILE_BREAK = 860;
  const header = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2');
  const desktopItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-nav-list__item'));
  if (!header || desktopItems.length === 0) {
    console.warn('Desktop nav: header or dropdown items not found.');
    return;
  }

  let docListenerAttached = false;

  function isMobile() {
    return window.innerWidth <= MOBILE_BREAK;
  }

  function getScrollbarWidth() {
    return window.innerWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  }

  function lockScrollStable() {
    const scrollbarWidth = getScrollbarWidth();
    document.documentElement.classList.add('no-scroll');
  }

  function unlockScrollStable() {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  }

  function closeItemsOnly() {
    desktopItems.forEach(item => {
      item.classList.remove('is-open');
      const l = item.querySelector('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
      const d = item.querySelector('.main-nav__dropdown');
      if (l) l.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      if (d) d.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    });
  }

  // Centralized close logic
  function closeAll() {
    closeItemsOnly();
    document.querySelectorAll('header.experiencefragment')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('fixed--header'));

    const overlay = document.querySelector('.nav-overlay');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');

    if (!isMobile()) {
      unlockScrollStable();
    }
    //added as part of bcl header v2
    document.querySelectorAll('.header-container.create-account__container')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

      document.querySelectorAll('.create-account__container_mobile')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

  }

  function closeCreateAccount() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.header-container.create-account__container')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.create-account__container_mobile')
      .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeLoginDropdown() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-dropdown__text.active')
      .forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeLanguageDropdown() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-languagenavigation__current-code.active')
      .forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function closeSearch() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-search-content-wrapper.active').forEach(function(panel) {
      const toggle = panel.parentElement && panel.parentElement.querySelector("[data-cmp-hook-search='search-toggle']");
      if (toggle) toggle.click();
    });
  }

  // Document click handler
  function onDocumentClickClose(e) {
    if (e && e.target) {
      const allDropdowns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav__dropdown'));
      if (allDropdowns.some(dd => dd && dd.contains(e.target))) {
        return; // ignore clicks inside dropdown
      }
    }

    if (docListenerAttached) {
      document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
      docListenerAttached = false;
    }

    closeAll();
  }

  function attachDocListenerOnce() {
    if (docListenerAttached) return;
    document.addEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
    docListenerAttached = true;
  }

  function setDropdownHeight(){
      let header = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2');
      let headerHeight = header ? header.offsetHeight : 0;

      // dropdown height
      let dropdownHeight = headerHeight;

      // eyebrow height (if exists)
      let eyebrow = document.querySelector('.bcl-eyebrow');
      if (eyebrow) {
          dropdownHeight += eyebrow.offsetHeight;
      }
      if(isMobile()){
          dropdownHeight = -dropdownHeight+5;
      }else{
          dropdownHeight = dropdownHeight;
      }

        document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav__dropdown').forEach(dropdown => {
          if(isMobile()){
              dropdown.style.top =0;
              dropdown.style.height = '100vh';
              dropdown.style.overflowY = 'auto';
          }else{
              dropdown.style.top = dropdownHeight + 'px';
              dropdown.style.height = 'auto';
          }
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-overlay').forEach(dropdown => {
          dropdown.style.top = dropdownHeight + 'px';
      });
  }

  desktopItems.forEach(item => {
    const link = item.querySelector('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
    const dropdown = item.querySelector('.main-nav__dropdown');
    if (!link || !dropdown) return;

    link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (isMobile()) return;
      e.preventDefault();

      const wasOpen = item.classList.contains('is-open');

      if (wasOpen) {
        closeAll();
        if (docListenerAttached) {
          document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
          docListenerAttached = false;
        }
        return;
      }

      closeItemsOnly();

      // If it was closed, open it now
      item.classList.add('is-open');

      document.querySelectorAll('header.experiencefragment')
        .forEach(h => h.classList.add('fixed--header'));

      document.querySelectorAll('.bcl-dropdown__text')
        .forEach(h => h.classList.remove('active'));

      link.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      dropdown.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

      const overlay = document.querySelector('.nav-overlay');
      if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('active');

      lockScrollStable();
      requestAnimationFrame(setDropdownHeight);

      setTimeout(attachDocListenerOnce, 0);
    });

    // Keyboard accessibility
    link.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (isMobile()) return;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        link.click();
      }
    });
  });


  function handleTabs() {
      const tabLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tab'))
          .filter(tab => !tab.classList.contains('link-tab')); // ignore link-tabs

      const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tabpanel');

      // bind click only to real tabs
      tabLinks.forEach(tab => {
          tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const panelId = tab.getAttribute('aria-controls').replace(/-tabpanel$/, '');

              // deactivate all
              tabLinks.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('cmp-tabs__tab--active'));
              tabPanels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active'));

              // activate selected
              tab.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tab--active');
              const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
              if (panel) panel.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active');
          });
      });

      if (tabLinks.length > 0) {
          tabLinks[0].click();
      }
  }

  function createAccountHandler() {

    const buttonWrapper = document.querySelector('.bcl-header-v2__main__secondary');
    if(buttonWrapper){
      const button = buttonWrapper.querySelector('.bcl-button');
      if(button){
        button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const container = document.querySelector('.header-container.create-account__container');
            const containerMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
            if (container && container.classList.contains('active')) {
                container.classList.remove('active');
                containerMobile.classList.remove('active');
            }else{
              closeAll();
              closeLoginDropdown();
              closeLanguageDropdown();
              closeSearch();
              container.classList.add('active');
              containerMobile.classList.add('active');
              if (isMobile()) {
                lockScrollStable();
              }
            }
          });

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const container = document.querySelector('.header-container.create-account__container');
            const containerMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
            if (container && container.classList.contains('active')) {
                if (!container.contains(e.target) && !button.contains(e.target)) {
                    container.classList.remove('active');
                    containerMobile.classList.remove('active');
                }
            }
          });

        const createAccountMobile = document.querySelector('.create-account__container_mobile');
        if (createAccountMobile) {
          const closeBtn = createAccountMobile.querySelector('.close-button');
          if (closeBtn) {
            closeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              closeAll();
              const menuToggle = document.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-header="menu-toggle"]');
              const menu = document.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-header="menu"]');
              if (menuToggle) menuToggle.classList.remove('active');
              if (menu) menu.classList.remove('active');
              unlockScrollStable();
            });
          }
        }
    }
  }
}

  if (!isMobile()) {
    handleTabs();
  }
  createAccountHandler();

  // Close create account when login dropdown, language nav, or search opens
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const loginTrigger = e.target.closest('.bcl-dropdown__text');
    const langTrigger = e.target.closest('.bcl-languagenavigation__current-code');
    const searchTrigger = e.target.closest("[data-cmp-hook-search='search-toggle']");
    if (loginTrigger || langTrigger) {
      closeCreateAccount();
    }
    if (searchTrigger) {
      // Close create account only when search is being opened (panel not yet active)
      const searchPanel = searchTrigger.parentElement &&
        searchTrigger.parentElement.querySelector('[data-cmp-hook-search="search"]');
      if (!searchPanel || !searchPanel.classList.contains('active')) {
        closeCreateAccount();
      }
    }
  });

  // ESC closes all
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (docListenerAttached) {
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
        docListenerAttached = false;
      }
      closeAll();
    }
  });


    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        const navLink = e.target.closest('.bcl-nav-list__item-link');
        if (!navLink) return;

        const width = window.innerWidth;

        // Only override between 861 and 1140
        if (width < 861 || width > 1140) return;

        const tablist = document.querySelectorAll(
            '.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tablist .cmp-tabs__tab'
        );
        if (!tablist.length) return;

        // Check if any tab already has active class
        const hasActiveTab = [...tablist].some(tab =>
            tab.classList.contains('cmp-tabs__tab--active')
        );

        // If any tab is already active, do not override
        if (hasActiveTab) return;


        const firstTab = document.querySelector(
            '.navtabs .cmp-tabs__tablist .cmp-tabs__tab'
        );
        if (!firstTab) return;

        // Activate first tab
        firstTab.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tab--active');

        // Activate its corresponding panel
        const panelId = firstTab.getAttribute('aria-controls');
        if (!panelId) return;

        const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.add('cmp-tabs__tabpanel--active');
        }
    });

  var lastWidth = window.innerWidth;
  // Cleanup on resize to mobile
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (isMobile()) {
      const currentWidth = window.innerWidth;
      // Ignore mobile browser UI resize during scroll
      if (currentWidth === lastWidth) return;

      lastWidth = currentWidth;

      closeAll();

      if (docListenerAttached) {
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocumentClickClose, true);
        docListenerAttached = false;
      }
    }
  });
  window.closeMegaMenu = closeAll;

})();
